title: Hot weather construction.
officialText:
The hot weather construction provisions of TMS 602/ACI 530.1/ASCE 6 Article 1.8D shall be
implemented when the temperature exceeds 100°F (37.8°C), or 90°F (32.2°C) with a wind-velocity greater than 8 mph (12.9
km/hr).
